In accordance with the provisions of Article 55 (3)
(b) read together with the provisions of Article 85
(1) of the Transitional Constitution of the Republic
of South Sudan, 2011, the National Legislature, with
the assent of the President of the Republic of South
Sudan, hereby enacts Act the following:
.

saving
matter of this Act is hereby repealed; provided that all

made and actions taken under the repealed
legislation, except to the extent they are cancelled
by or are otherwise inconsistent with provisions of
this Act, shall remain in full force and effect, until
they are repealed or amended in accordance with the
provisions of this Act.

territory in the Republic of South Sudan.

“Abroad” means outside the customs territory;
“Ad valorem duties and taxes” means duties and taxies

proper officer writing that he or she intends to act

by customs service to be signed by an agent;

“Customs offence” means any breach or attempted

“Customs port” means an area designated or

“Customs transit operation” means transport of goods

“Customs warehouse” means any place approved by

“Data” means any information recorded in a from in
